text.p: Morocco's mortgage firm Credit Hotelier et Immobilier expanded its 375 million dirham ($39.4 million) debenture bonds issue to 500 million after the issue was oversubscribed 2.1 times, a broker said on Monday.
The original issue consisted of 2,500 bonds each worth 150,000 dirhams, at 10.5 percent rate and was open from June 17-27. The bonds will be introduced on the stock exchange on July 1, 1997.
Last year, CIH issued around 1.05 billion dirhams in state-guaranteed debentures.
The state owns a majority stake in the bank, which holds 65 percent of the Moroccan mortgage market. The bank is on a list of companies due for privatisation this year.
Hotels have borrowings with CIH totalling 5.5 billion dirhams while overall doubtful debts amounted to 3.5 billion dirhams at the end of 1996, the Upline Securities spokeswoman told Reuters.
last traded on June 26 at 285 dirhams.
